name: Brownie
gmNotes: A Brownie is a lower-ranking domestic helper-Fey, usually contracted through a laboratory or milk hub. Brownies perform household labour for milk, cream, and honey used to support Takelings and clones. Their brown caps are dust-and-smoke filters. Direct payment, gifts, formal naming, or explicit gratitude-settlement may terminate the household contract. Brownie is a fey-role Archetype, not a Species. See the Brownie Lore Card and the searchable Fey reference dossiers for reveal-safe detail.
description: An elusive household spirit said to work while the family sleeps. Brownies are helpful but capricious, and the wrong gift or word may make one leave forever.
